# Know Your Meme & Scientific American

> > A mixed collection documenting internet culture through Know Your Meme's viral TikTok trends and meme explanations, alongside Scientific American's science journalism subscription offerings.

This site combines meme documentation from Know Your Meme—tracking viral trends across TikTok, Twitter, and other social platforms—with Scientific American content including subscription information and legal pages. The primary focus is on contemporary internet culture and social media phenomena.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends and viral videos
- Exploitable memes and image macros
- Know Your Meme documentation
- Viral social media phenomena
- Dance memes and challenges
- Catchphrases and slang
- Hood culture and nostalgia
- Scientific American journalism
- Social platform crossover (Twitter/X, Facebook, DeviantArt)
- Internet culture explainers
- Meme origins and spread patterns
- Contemporary viral moments

## TikTok Viral Trends

- [We Still Talk About You | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme featuring art of girl lying over cat, viral on TikTok
- [I'm Talking About Innit | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend from BunnaB & YKNiece's 'Innit' with swimming gesture
